project_spherical — 3D lidar_projection op

• 数据种类:points → image2d

• 调用:import spherical_proj; spherical_proj.project_spherical(points, h_res: 'int' = 1024, v_res: 'int' = 64, v_fov=(-25.0, 15.0)) -> 'np.ndarray'(或 ops3d.get("project_spherical"))
